name: System Program
learn: The core Solana system program creates accounts, transfers lamports, and allocates account data. Almost every Solana transaction touches it directly or indirectly.

name: SPL Token Program
learn: The canonical SPL Token program defines fungible token mints, token accounts, minting, burning, and transfers across the Solana ecosystem.

name: Associated Token Account Program
learn: The associated token account program derives and creates the canonical token account for a wallet and mint pair, removing ambiguity around where SPL balances live.

name: Metaplex Token Metadata Program
learn: Metaplex token metadata stores NFT and fungible token metadata accounts, collection relationships, creators, and programmable asset metadata for the Solana NFT stack.

name: Jupiter Swap Program
learn: Jupiter is the dominant Solana DEX aggregator. Its swap program powers route execution across multiple AMMs so applications can fetch and settle the best available path.

name: Raydium AMM v4
learn: Raydium AMM v4 is one of the most widely integrated Solana liquidity programs. It backs a large share of token launches and AMM liquidity routes across the ecosystem.
